newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka says 58 troops,210 rebels killed in attack.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka says 58 troops,210 rebels killed in attack.

text.p: Sri Lanka said on Wednesday that 58 special forces troops and 210 rebels were killed when the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) separatists attacked the military's forward defences in the north on Tuesday.
"Fifty-eight bodies of special forces troops were recovered in the clearing operation now going on," a Defence Ministry spokesman told Reuters.

The spokesman said about 1,000 rebels had taken part in the pre-dawn attack on the military positions near the northern government-held frontline town of Vavuniya, 220 km (135 miles) north of the capital Colombo, on Tuesday.
He said 12 military officers and 86 troops were wounded in the attack. More than 300 rebels were also believed to have been wounded, he added.

The spokesman said the army destroyed three of its own artillery guns and some ammunition to prevent them from falling into the hands of the rebels, who are fighting for a separate homeland for minority Tamils in Sri Lanka's north and east.
